items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: All you hear is Sy Oliver and Eddie Wilcox, you know.

ctx.x: Nobody -- if you mention Billy Moore -- William Moore, nobody know who it was. But we knew. And then he had another guy, Roger Segur. He had another guy Bud Estees. Don Redman used to write for Lunceford. See, all these people that you never knew. You'd say oh, that's the Lunceford sound. But that's not so. That was a lot of different arrangers were writing for that band. Anybody who made a good arrangement.
Eddie Durham did a lot of good arrangements for Lunceford's band. But you don't hear those names associated with Lunceford. All you hear is Sy Oliver and Eddie Wilcox, you know.
